checkin_1.text: {H}，你还好吗？需要帮忙的话，就说
checkin_1.pinyin: {H}, nǐ hái hǎo ma? Xūyào bāngmáng de huà, jiù shuō 'bāngmáng'.

checkin_2.pinyin: {H}! Nǐ hái hǎo ma? Shuō 'méishì', huòzhě 'bāngmáng'.

checkin_3.text: {H}，我想确定你安全。可以的话，说
checkin_3.pinyin: {H}, wǒ xiǎng quèdìng nǐ ānquán. Kěyǐ de huà, shuō 'méishì'.

ack_ok.text: 好的，{H}。有需要的话我在这里。
ack_ok.pinyin: Hǎo de, {H}. Yǒu xūyào de huà wǒ zài zhèlǐ.
ack_ok.notes: Spoken when resident confirms they're OK

recheck.pinyin: {H}, nǐ zìjǐ kěyǐ qǐlái ma? Shuō 'kěyǐ' huòzhě 'bù kěyǐ'.
recheck.notes: D6 - asking if can get up after saying OK but still on floor

alert_sent.text: 我已经通知{C}了，有人会来帮你。会痛的话，不要勉强起来。
alert_sent.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tōngzhī {C} le, yǒu rén huì lái bāng nǐ. Huì tòng de huà, bùyào miǎnqiǎng qǐlái.

offline.text: 我正在联系你的家人，我会响警报让邻居听到。
offline.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài liánxì nǐ de jiārén, wǒ huì xiǎng jǐngbào ràng línjū tīngdào.
offline.notes: D10 - internet down, local alarm will sound
